title: Verifox Email Verifier
description: Bulk-verify email deliverability with Verifox. No API key needed — you only pay for emails that successfully verify.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses to verify. Paste a list, or map in a field from another Actor's dataset.

mode.title: Verification mode
mode.description: auto = pick per list size (bulk when > 500). realtime = one request per email, streamed. bulk = submit the whole list to the Verifox bulk API, then collect results.

concurrency.title: Concurrency (realtime mode)
concurrency.description: How many emails to verify in parallel in realtime mode (1–20). Higher is faster.

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL (advanced)
apiBaseUrl.description: Override the Verifox API base URL. Leave as default unless told otherwise.
